message.content:
**July 4, 1776**

On this day the Second Continental Congress formally **adopted** the text of the Declaration of Independence. While the document itself was drafted earlier (the draft was presented on June 28), it wasn’t until July 4 that the delegates voted “in favor” and officially declared America’s separation from Britain.

> *Note:* Although the adoption took place on July 4, the majority of the signers affixed their names at different times—most notably on **August 2, 1776**, when the first official copies were printed and distributed. Some signatures appeared as late as early September or even into 1781‑82, reflecting delays caused by travel, illness, and other circumstances. Nonetheless, July 4 remains the celebrated anniversary of the Declaration’s formal approval.
